Name: Argob, Officer of Pekahiah
Summary: Argob was with Pekahiah in the palace at Samaria when Pekah conspired and smote the king; he is named among those slain with him.
RelatedPeople: Pekahiah, King of Israel; Pekah, King of Israel; Arieh, Officer of Pekahiah
LifeLesson: Standing beside a doomed king is itself a danger.
